scope: all 1488 scoped grounding rows; concrete voice/date contradictions only
method: Inspected every scoped row accepted_disposition_pointers, compared state/reason/date/units against accepted primary dispositions, and retained ordinary unpaired or out-of-period contextual rows. Reported only explicit excluded voice, oral-notes role, or multi-section date collapses.

findings.exact_existing_evidence: The accepted disposition is genuine_excluded: exclude_from_individually_authored_darwin_grounding; voice is editorial, collective memorialists and quoted earlier authorities; Charles only a signatory. Its date scope says 18 Nov 1858 applies to the second memorial, not every extracted block.
findings.safe_disposition_correction: Set disposition to excluded from individually authored Darwin grounding; retain collective memorial text and signatory separately. Split the 18 Nov date to the applicable second memorial section and do not expose all 66 units as Darwin prose.

findings.exact_existing_evidence: The row uses structure single_xml_day with earliest/latest 1832-03-01 although original_label is 8 & 26 Feb & 1 Mar [1832], and units include sections beginning 8 February, Feb 26 and March 1.
findings.safe_disposition_correction: Replace the scalar date treatment with section dates (8 Feb, 26 Feb, 1 Mar) and retain the supplied Beagle source bounds; do not use 1 Mar as the date of the whole multi-section letter.

findings.contradiction: date range collapsed to one day
findings.exact_existing_evidence: The row uses structure single_xml_day and earliest/latest 1845-09-03 although original_label is 3[–4] Sept 1845; its third retained unit begins Thursday morning, representing the later dated section.
findings.safe_disposition_correction: Retain 3–4 Sept as a qualified section/date range and keep later-section content separate; do not treat all three units as composed on 3 Sept.

findings.contradiction: oral research notes misclassified as ordinary letter
findings.exact_existing_evidence: The accepted disposition is oral_research_notes_grounding_only with voice Darwin_notes_with_attributed_speech. The row reason is ordinary_individual_Darwin_body_exact_single_XML_day and its units expose APPENDIX III, “Darwin’s notes arising from conversations with Joseph Dalton Hooker”, and Hooker-attributed statements.
findings.safe_disposition_correction: Classify as Darwin research notes with attributed speech, not an ordinary individual letter. Preserve the 8 Dec note date but exclude Hooker statements from Darwin voice and do not infer a correspondent reply edge.

limitations: This report is navigation evidence only; no ledger, working report, source, or export was changed.
No blanket exclusion was applied to contextual or missing-prompt Darwin prose.
The 1732 and 2222 enclosure corrections were not repeated.
